candidate.title: AI Agents | Web Search For LLMs | LangGraph & Tavily Tutorial
candidate.description:
In this video, you will learn how to use the LangChain Tavily integration to build web search tools for LLMs and creating web-powered ai agents using Langgraph.

Specifically, you will learn how to :
- Get a free API key for Tavily
- Use multiple Tavily Search arguments from the documentation
- Create a search tool using the langchain-tavily integration
- Build an AI agent using langgraph
- Compare the web-powered AI agent to a raw LLM in a real use-case

Don't forget to like and subscribe to the channel !
